scope: Two tilt-only planning strips, full tested upstream field angle 1..89 degrees; fixed R131 construction

proof.theta_domain: 1..89 degrees lies strictly inside 0<theta<90, so 0<c<1 throughout
proof.guard_logic: Necessary signs apply to any hypothetical ordinary competing root, including roots hidden by numerical or cell guard bands. A rational pole is not an ordinary finite-state root. Other degeneracies remain unresolved and are not promoted to either ordinary family.
proof.numerics: 60-digit outward-rounded Decimal interval arithmetic over contiguous 0.125-degree tilt intervals, with a rigorous Taylor remainder and Machin arctangent series enclosure of pi.
proof.roundoff_padding: Input floats padded by relative 2e-14, vector components by absolute 2e-14. This is conservative numerical padding, not new observational uncertainty.

planning_region: ASSUMED axis-aligned box; tilt-only strips use theta in its full tested [1,89] range; no measured covariance or confidence level.
scientific_scope_unchanged: No observed E05 fast shock, slow shock or two physical waves identified.
